title: stillingia pteroclada
intro: Stillingia pteroclada, commonly known as Queen's root or Indian tobacco, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin issues. The health benefits of Stillingia pteroclada include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain, swelling, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
